Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Take another ui lane seat" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

Shared-file rules for every Studio Interfaces card this round (from ui seat 1, which holds the neighbouring work):
- Draft PR #26942 (#25922 S5) moves the remaining `engine.studio.*` rows, the Interfaces family `engine.studio.if.*` included, out of `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` into `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`. ⛔ Add or edit no row in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`; write new rows only in the studio namespace files, and a zh test preloads with `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is shared with ui seat 1's #26730 (the Interfaces refusal strip ≈L4683 gets an `onShow`), #26733 (props on the four `StudioRail` call sites, Interfaces ≈L5104) and PR #26920 (≈L1270–1330), plus the other seat-5 Interfaces cards named below. Keep your hunks inside your declared region; whoever lands second merges `origin/main` and resolves.

Shared files: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` is a lane-wide hot file: seat 4's PR #27120 (#27052) and seat 5's PR #27180 (#26988, queued) both edit it. Seat 4's PR #27120 also edits `plugin-detail` `RecordPageColumns.tsx`, `index.tsx`, `useDetailTranslation.ts` and `synth/recordPageColumns.ts`: ⛔ stay out of those. No open PR touches `DetailSection.tsx`, `HeaderHighlight.tsx` or `RecordFieldAccessScope` at 2026-10-28T10:00Z; ui seat 1 confirmed no collision and stood down from this card. Measure again at your first edit.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Ruling 6457467702, letter B (on #26594): the field lock on a held row is the server's answer, ⛔ never a client `when` evaluator. Triage 2026-10-28T08:59Z: "One source: ask the same record projection the edit dialog now asks. No second resolver." The card's declared limitation stands: the list view's inline edit locks a whole column and keeps the row-blind answer; say so where that surface is documented (only if a doc already describes it).

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

On `origin/main` `b322b5da`:
- `plugin-detail` `DetailSection.tsx` ≈L507 and `HeaderHighlight.tsx` ≈L211 resolve inline-edit write through `resolveFieldAffordance('recordEdit', perms, objectName, field.name)`, which reads `usePermissions()`, the row-blind `/auth/me/permissions` answer.
- `@object-ui/permissions` already exports `RecordFieldAccessScope` (`object`, `recordId`, `load`, `revision`): below it, `usePermissions().checkField` answers from the record projection (`GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id/field-access`, #27063). So wrapping the detail page's sections in that scope should flip both call sites with no change at the call sites themselves.
- `plugin-form/src/recordFieldAccess.tsx` (`RecordFieldAccessForForm`, not exported) is the edit dialog's mount: it asks only for a stored record when the data source has `getRecordFieldAccess`, and bumps `revision` on the data source's write report for this record and on the data-invalidation bus. `plugin-detail` depends on `@object-ui/permissions` and `@object-ui/react` but not on `plugin-form`.
- The seam: one mount around the record page's detail body, where the record id is known, covering every `DetailSection` and `HeaderHighlight` on the page. Prefer a mount inside `plugin-detail` (e.g. where `DetailView` or the `record:details` / header blocks get their record). Mount in `RecordDetailView.tsx` only if no plugin-detail point covers the whole page, and then as one wrapper outside #27120's and #27180's hunks.
- Reuse over copy: if mounting the published `RecordFieldAccessScope` in `plugin-detail` needs the same ask conditions and refresh signals `RecordFieldAccessForForm` holds, either keep the copy minimal (state why in the PR) or move that wrapper to a package both can import. A new export from a published package is Clause-② `yes`: declare it in the PR body, never silently.

### Scope

File surface: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/` (the mount; `DetailSection.tsx` / `HeaderHighlight.tsx` only if the mount cannot reach them), possibly `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/recordFieldAccess.tsx` and `ui/packages/permissions/src/` if the wrapper moves, tests beside. Tests (acceptance): with a field permission whose server projection marks a field editable on this row while `/auth/me/permissions` locks it, the detail page's inline edit offers that field (section and header highlight); with the projection locking it, it stays locked; a data source without `getRecordFieldAccess` keeps the row-blind answer; a save that moves the row re-asks. Ablation: drop the mount and the row-admitted case turns red.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate expected (measure). `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium` (M). `Clause-②: no` unless the wrapper moves to a new export (then `yes`, declared). `Metadata-protocol: none`. Changesets: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch (and any other published package you change).
